concepts.def: Changing direction quickly while keeping control.
Keeping centre of mass over the base of support.
Smooth movement of two or more body parts.
Distance ÷ time — how fast you move.

walkthroughs.body_html: Speed = distance ÷ time. A runner covers 30 m in 4 s. Speed = 30 ÷ 4 = 7.5 m/s. Used to rank sprinters and assess progression.
Football — agility, coordination, CV endurance. Gymnastics — flexibility, balance, power. 100 m sprint — power, speed, reaction time. Long-distance running — CV endurance, muscular endurance.

The bleep test is maximal — motivation affects results. Sit-and-reach measures hamstring + lower back, not whole-body flexibility. Use multiple tests and re-test under same conditions to track progress fairly.
